metadata.description: Role-based skill bundles, install profiles, and capability modules for targeted installation. Bundles remain the canonical role grouping; profiles select coarse install scope (minimal / core / full); modules group skills by capability tag for fine-grained selection.

profiles.name: Minimal
profiles.description: Smallest workable install: core developer fundamentals only. Use when disk space or context size matters more than breadth.

profiles.name: Core
profiles.description: Default for most developers: core developer bundle plus testing, refactoring, and PR review skills.

profiles.name: Full
profiles.description: Everything in the catalog. Equivalent to the no-flag default install.

modules.name: Testing
modules.description: Unit, integration, E2E, property-based, and mutation testing skills.

modules.name: Code Review
modules.description: Multi-axis code review: quality, intent, testing, security.

modules.name: Security Operations
modules.description: Defensive security, dependency audits, vulnerability analysis.

modules.name: AI Engineering
modules.description: Skills for building agents, RAG, prompts, and AI evaluation.

modules.name: Documentation
modules.description: Technical writing, READMEs, ADRs, API docs.

bundles.name: Core Developer
bundles.description: Essential skills for any software developer: planning, testing, debugging, and code quality.

bundles.name: Frontend Engineer
bundles.description: Skills for frontend and full-stack developers working with React, Next.js, and browser testing.

bundles.name: Backend Engineer
bundles.description: Skills for backend developers building APIs, databases, and server-side systems.

bundles.name: AI Engineer
bundles.description: Skills for developers building AI agents, RAG pipelines, and LLM-powered applications.

bundles.name: Software Architect
bundles.description: Skills for system design, architecture decisions, and large-scale patterns.

bundles.name: DevOps Engineer
bundles.description: Skills for CI/CD, containerization, infrastructure, deployment, and observability.

bundles.name: Security Specialist
bundles.description: Skills for application security, authentication, vulnerability analysis, and compliance auditing.

bundles.name: Compliance Auditor
bundles.description: Full compliance and governance skill set for regulated industries.

bundles.name: QA Engineer
bundles.description: Comprehensive testing skills from unit tests through E2E, property-based, and mutation testing.

bundles.name: Bug Hunter
bundles.description: Skills for finding, diagnosing, and fixing bugs with systematic localization, reproduction, and root-cause analysis.

bundles.name: Release Prep
bundles.description: End-to-end pre-release workflow: clean docs and root layout, bump the version, sync documentation, and write release notes.

bundles.name: Incident Response
bundles.description: One-click skill set for incident response: SRE patterns, postmortems, operational runbooks, on-call runbooks, rollback strategy, observability, and log-based debugging.

bundles.name: PR Workflow
bundles.description: Pull request authoring and review: commit hygiene, PR description authoring, multi-axis code review (quality, intent, testing, security).

bundles.name: Architecture Docs
bundles.description: Architecture decision-making and documentation: design, ADRs, technical docs, API contracts, domain-driven design, and component boundaries.

bundles.name: Tech Lead
bundles.description: Skills for technical leadership: architecture, code review, documentation, and team workflows.
